Description: CloudWatch Dashboards for Lambda Shutdown Pattern Analysis (Overview + Deep Dive)

LogGroupName.Description: CloudWatch Log Group name for the Lambda function with telemetry extension

DashboardBody.Fn::Sub:
{"widgets":[{"type":"text","x":0,"y":0,"width":12,"height":4,"properties":{"markdown":"## Lambda Shutdown Pattern Analysis

**How to read this dashboard:**

| Widget | What it shows | How to interpret |
|--------|--------------|-----------------|
| **Analysis Table** | Shutdown metrics grouped by speed (Fast/Medium/Slow) | Compare columns across rows. High SevereDropCount = traffic decline causing shutdowns. High HighIdleCount = environments idle too long. |
| **Shutdown Speed Pie** | Proportion of fast vs medium vs slow shutdowns | Dominated by Fast? Consider keep-alive or provisioned concurrency. Dominated by Slow? Focus on other optimizations. |
| **Idle Gap Distribution** | How long environments wait between invocations | Gaps < 5s = scaling-driven cold starts. Gaps > 30s = idle recycling, keep-alive would help. |
| **Traffic Drop vs Shutdown** | Whether traffic decline correlates with shutdown speed | All Severe? Keep-alive works. Spread? Provisioned concurrency is better. |

>> [Deep Dive Dashboard](https://${Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${Region}#dashboards:name=Lambda-Shutdown-Deep-Dive)
","background":"transparent"}},{"type":"text","x":12,"y":0,"width":12,"height":10,"properties":{"markdown":"## AI Recommendations

Run the recommendation pipeline to analyze shutdown patterns and get actionable insights:

```
aws stepfunctions start-execution --state-machine-arn <RecommendationPipelineArn> --input '{"startTime": <epoch_start>, "endTime": <epoch_end>}'
```

The pipeline will:
1. Extract all shutdown metrics for the time range
2. Run cold start correlation analysis
3. Generate AI recommendations via Bedrock
4. Update this widget with results
